figures.description: Show the first product store beside the full64-bit accumulator and outgoing carry. Annotate the split at bit32 and the unchanged remaining product columns.
figures.expectedObservation: The first word is00000001 and the outgoing carry isfffffffe.

figures.description: Show the four stored sum limbs and the separate final carry, with the modulus beside them. Annotate bit128 outside the stored object.
figures.expectedObservation: The stored low sum is2^128 minus320, below N, but its carry is one so subtraction is required.

figures.description: Show the private remainder and saved bit index before the public output copy. Annotate the difference between private scratch and the caller output sentinel.
figures.expectedObservation: The private remainder is one and the bit index is minus one; caller output is still sentinel bytes.

figures.description: Show all sixteen output bytes before the supplied full-width restore. Annotate the little-endian low bytes, zero high limbs and still-allocated private frame.
figures.expectedObservation: The output begins e6 0a followed by fourteen zero bytes. The frame remains allocated until execution continues through the supplied restore.
